Go beyond the headlines every morning and join some of FOX News’ most exceptional journalists—including FOX News Channel reporters Peter Doocy, Aishah Hasnie, Bill Melugin, Alex Hogan, Lucas Tomlinson and Jacqui Heinrich and FOX News Radio reporters Dave Anthony, Jessica Rosenthal, Lisa Brady, and Gurnal Scott - as they tap into the global reporting resources of FOX News and get unparalleled political analysis and exclusive insight from top newsmakers. The Rundown offers a sharp contrast of perspectives you won’t hear anywhere else, and a daily commentary you can't miss, we deliver the full picture of the day's biggest events.

item.title: Battleground Iowa: Economic Strain and High Diesel Prices Loom Over Iowa’s Competitive Midterm Races
item.description:
In this special battleground state edition of The FOX News Rundown: Evening Edition, FOX's Jacqui Heinrich takes a look at the tight congressional and gubernatorial races in the state.
Nominees in Iowa’s toss-up Senate race are sparring over high prices and transgender issues. Rep. Ashley Hinson (R-IA) campaigned with President Trump, who won Iowa by double digits, but is distancing herself from him on issues like Iran. State Rep. Josh Turek seeks to become Iowa’s first elected Democratic senator since 2008. He’ll visit a farm today to highlight how high costs are challenging the state’s critical agriculture industry.
Megan Goldberg, Assistant Professor of American politics at Cornell College, who says the normally very 'red state' has changed over the past few years.

item.title: Decoys, Legal Fights And The Final Nasty Days Before The Midterms
item.description:
A bombshell report in Alaska is shaking up the final days before the midterm elections. Following allegations that a candidate named Daniel J. Sullivan was placed on the ballot to potentially siphon votes and confuse voters in the race against Democratic Senate Candidate Mary Peltola, investigations into the matter are underway. "FOX News Sunday" Anchor and host of the Livin' the Bream Podcast Shannon Bream joins the Rundown to break down the legal and political fallout of the alleged scheme and what it means for the race just days away from election day.
With just days until the election, the battle for Congress boils down to one question: Are voters feeling the headline growth, or the squeeze at the checkout counter? FOX Business Contributor, co-host of Big Money in the Morning, and editor of the Barron’s Investor’s Circle newsletter Josh Schafer discusses the mixed economic data, like strong GDP and steady jobs—the reality of grocery and gas prices rising faster than wages, and how the massive AI tech buildout is driving Wall Street momentum.
PLUS, commentary by FOX News contributor Joe Concha.
PHOTO CREDIT: AP IMAGES

item.title: Battleground Maine: Sen. Collins Fights to Hold Maine—and the Senate Majority
item.description:
In this special battleground state edition of The FOX News Rundown: Evening Edition, FOX's Peter Doocy takes a look into another neck and neck Senate race, this one in Maine.
In Maine, Sen. Susan Collins (R-ME), is the only Republican incumbent running in a state that went for Kamala Harris in 2024. Collins' Democratic challenger is Troy Jackson, former president of the state Senate who jumped into the race to replace the scandal-plagued Graham Platner. The race shows the candidates tied, with Jackson and Collins at 49% apiece. A recent A Fox News poll showed 53% of voters are concerned Collins votes with Trump too much, and by contrast, 46% are concerned Jackson is too liberal.
Mathew Continetti, journalist and Director of Domestic Policy Studies at the American Enterprise Institute, joins the podcast and says this Senate race could be very telling for the GOP if early polling shows Senator Collins in trouble.

item.title: Midterm Crunch Time: Are Democrats Too Confident Heading Into Tuesday?
item.description:
Midterm polling is showing close races all around the nation ahead of this election, but how much can voters actually trust the numbers coming out of key battleground states? FOX News Contributor and host of the "The Hugh Hewitt Show" Hugh Hewitt joins the Rundown to break down the latest campaign stops, key Senate races, and why he compares polling season to candy corn. He also dives into how both parties are framing economic issues and fraud allegations.
As the midterm elections loom, political analysts are closely watching whether shifting voter sentiment and sliding approval ratings for President Trump could upend control of Capitol Hill. Veteran Democratic pollster and Schoen-Cooperman Research founder Doug Schoen joins to discuss competitive Senate showdowns from Texas to Michigan, assess whether Democrats are riding an authentic blue surge or simply capitalizing on a "red retreat," and deliver his bottom-line forecast for election night.
PLUS, commentary by Rich Zeoli, host of The Rich Zeoli Podcast.

item.title: Battleground Michigan: Home of the Race That Decides America’s Future?
item.description:
In this special battleground state edition of The FOX News Rundown: Evening Edition, FOX's Aishah Hasnie takes a look into the extremely close Michigan Senate race.
The tight 2026 U.S. Senate race in Michigan features Republican former U.S. Rep. Mike Rogers and Democratic nominee Abdul El-Sayed, with a recent Fox News Poll showing a statistical dead heat at 50% for El-Sayed and 49% for Rogers. As the midterm campaign enters it final week, Mike Rogers looks to be building a powerful ground game and expanding coalitions in key areas like Detroit. Meanwhile, Democratic opponent Abdul El Sayed looks to be struggling to connect with core voter groups on the trail.
Matt Whitlock, Senior Vice President of CRC Advisors, joins the podcast and says Rogers still has work to do but Michigan voters could be showing they are having issues with El-Sayed's character combined with what can be described as anti-American comments.

item.title: How High-Stakes Governors Races Could Shift National Power
item.description:
With 36 gubernatorial races on the ballot next Tuesday, the Cato Freedom Index highlights that nine of the top 10 states for individual and economic freedom are led by Republicans. Republican Governors Association Chair and Montana Governor Greg Gianforte discusses the battle between red and blue state policies, highlighting key potential flips in Wisconsin and Oregon, pushback against progressive socialist agendas in California, and why kitchen-table issues and public safety will drive voters to the polls despite national political headwinds.
With Election Day just days away, New Jersey Congressman Tom Kean Jr. (R) joins the Rundown to discuss his fight to hold onto the Republican majority in Congress. Kean makes his case for reelection, highlighting affordability, tax relief and bipartisan achievements while outlining his positions on Iran. He also addresses questions about his health, missed votes and stock trading as he faces a competitive race in New Jersey’s 7th Congressional District.
PLUS, commentary by Gregg Jarrett, FOX News legal analyst and commentator.
PHOTO CREDIT: AP IMAGES
